inputSchema.description: one audit entry; the verdict is expected.outcome "ok" or expectedError.code, the first failing rule of: UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION, CANONICAL_MISSING, HASH_MISMATCH, CANONICAL_FIELD_MISMATCH, INVALID_ENTRY_TYPE, INVALID_V8_FIELD, INVALID_OUTPUT_HASH, INVALID_ENTRY_SHAPE

entry.description: an audit entry as stored (canonical, hash and every field)

cases.description: a hashed field changed after sealing
schemaVersion as a string is not supported
KILL_SWITCH with a null inputHash (it states UNAVAILABLE)
DECISION with an outputHash that is not 64 hex
a v8 entry of an unknown type
a v7 entry of a v8-only type
DLP_TRANSFORM whose reason does not match its action
DLP_TRANSFORM with a malformed dlp object
APPROVAL_DECIDED allowed with the reason DENIED
DELEGATION_ISSUED whose executionContext lacks the delegation key
